note: Static methodology facts for the dashboard's 'how it works' levels. Sourced from backtest_report.md and saved model files; see sources per section.

architecture.description: Ensemble of three margin components predicting home-team margin.

components.name: ELO
components.what: Strength rating from game results; beating stronger opponents moves it more. Linear regression maps ELO differential to margin.

components.name: EPA-linear
components.what: Linear regression on 8 EPA/success-rate differentials (offense, defense, pass/rush splits).

components.name: GBM
components.what: Gradient boosting on ELO diff, EPA differentials, rest-day differential, division-game flag, week; captures nonlinear matchup patterns. Refit weekly on the expanding window.

architecture.weights_selected: tuned by MAE on the 2021-2022 validation window
architecture.pick_rule: paper pick when |predicted margin - market spread| >= 3.0

training_periods.gbm: walk-forward, retrained weekly on expanding window (each prediction used only games already played)

epa_differentials: off_epa_diff: offensive EPA/play, home minus away
def_epa_diff: defensive EPA/play allowed, home minus away
def_pass_diff / def_rush_diff: pass/rush EPA allowed splits

elo_methodology.update: weekly batching (all games in a week use pre-week ratings); win/loss outcome scaled by a margin-of-victory multiplier

epa_methodology.plays: nflverse play-by-play, pass/run plays with non-null EPA
epa_methodology.weekly_update: EWMA with alpha=0.25 on the new week's per-team means
epa_methodology.offseason: 35% regression toward league average (0.0) at week 1

validation.method: walk-forward: linears fit 2018-2020, GBM retrained weekly, weights/threshold tuned on 2021-2022 validation, final verdict on locked 2023-2025 test

locked_test_2023_2025.roi: +0.9% at -110 (inside statistical noise; breakeven 52.4% within +/-3.1pp SE)
locked_test_2023_2025.totals: not bettable: negative ROI at every threshold

validation.honest_verdict: No verified edge. The market's spread predicts final margins better than the model (9.79 vs 10.22 MAE). V1 is the ceiling given this information set.
